title: Classify European conditional descriptor banks
changes: Document 23 source-backed EUR descriptor bank pointers and 684 conditional eight-byte records with original count bounds, keeping bank0 and the bank22 gap separate.
validation: Checked the exact EUR ROM, original Wine disassemblies and jump table, each bank count and source digest against the e97 manifest; no overlapping owner.
limitations: Other guest selectors remain unrestricted; bank0, the bank22 gap, all-caller reachability, model, runtime, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
